boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus study environments, from reservable library rooms and research collections to residence-hall study lounges with specific access limits.

cards.title: Bring the whole project to Totus Tuus
cards.subtitle: Reservable group room in St. John Paul II Library
cards.notes: Reserve this ground-floor room for collaborative work, then use its large table, reference books, chalkboards, and whiteboard.
cards.short_summary: A visually distinctive reservable room equipped for group planning and presentation practice.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan University identifies this ground-floor library room as reservable by students and documents its large table, lounge chair, chalkboards, whiteboard, and reference collection.
cards.source_title: Franciscan University Students Furbish New Totus Tuus Group Study Room
cards.access_notes: Open for Franciscan University students to reserve for study, meetings, or group events; confirm availability through the library.

cards.entity_name: St. John Paul II Library Quiet Study Areas
cards.title: Settle into the library's quiet side
cards.subtitle: Quiet study areas across two library floors
cards.notes: Choose a quiet area when reading or drafting calls for fewer interruptions; check the library's posted hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A low-distraction option distributed throughout the university's central library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library's official About Us page states that St. John Paul II Library provides quiet study areas throughout its two floors.
cards.source_title: About Us | St. John Paul II Library
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to the library's current building hours and university access rules; consult the library homepage before visiting.

cards.entity_name: St. John Paul II Library Computer Lab
cards.title: Move screen-heavy work to the computer lab
cards.subtitle: Dedicated computer workspace inside the library
cards.notes: Use the lab for assignments that need a campus computer or library resources, and verify current building access before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A library-based workstation environment for research and computer-dependent coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library site identifies a computer lab among the study resources inside the St. John Paul II Library building.
cards.access_notes: Available within the library during applicable building hours; the cited page does not state workstation eligibility or login requirements.

cards.entity_name: St. John Paul II Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Give collaborative work a room of its own
cards.subtitle: Group study rooms on both library floors
cards.notes: Bring discussion-based assignments here and ask library staff about room availability or reservation requirements before settling in.
cards.short_summary: Multiple enclosed library spaces intended for students working together.
cards.evidence_claim: The official library About Us page states that group study rooms are available throughout both floors of St. John Paul II Library.
cards.source_title: About Us | St. John Paul II Library
cards.access_notes: Room-specific reservation rules are not stated on the cited page; confirm availability and any booking requirement with library staff.

cards.title: Work directly with Franciscan's archival record
cards.subtitle: First-floor research room in St. John Paul II Library
cards.notes: Contact the archives before planning a source-based project; materials are rare, remain in the room, and have limited access.
cards.short_summary: A supervised research setting for university records, photographs, publications, and memorabilia.
cards.evidence_claim: The library places Archives and Special Collections on the first floor and says its rare or unique materials have limited access and cannot be checked out.
cards.source_title: Archives & Special Collections | St. John Paul II Library
cards.access_notes: Access is limited, and archival materials cannot be checked out; contact the library or archives before arranging research.

cards.entity_name: St. Francis Hall Top-Floor Study Lounge
cards.title: Take focused work to the top floor
cards.subtitle: Residence-hall study lounge with wireless access
cards.notes: Residents can bring independent work upstairs to the designated study lounge; follow hall quiet-hours and common-area policies.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-labeled study lounge separated from the hall's central floor lobbies.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan Residence Life documents a study lounge on the top floor of St. Francis Hall and wireless internet access in the hall.
cards.access_notes: This is inside a men's residence hall; use is governed by residence-hall entry, common-area, and quiet-hours policies.

cards.entity_name: St. Thomas More Hall Second-Floor Study Room
cards.title: Use the second-floor room for dorm-side study
cards.subtitle: Dedicated study room with hall-wide Wi-Fi
cards.notes: Residents can shift coursework out of their rooms and into this designated second-floor space while observing hall access rules.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall study room supported by Wi-Fi throughout the building.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Residence Life page identifies a study room on St. Thomas More Hall's second floor and states that Wi-Fi is available throughout the building.
cards.source_title: St. Thomas More Hall | Residence Life
cards.access_notes: This is inside a women's residence hall; access is subject to residence-hall entry and common-area policies.

cards.entity_name: Bl. Solanus Casey Hall Second-Floor Study Room
cards.title: Keep lower-campus coursework close to home
cards.subtitle: Second-floor study room in Bl. Solanus Casey Hall
cards.notes: Use this designated room for residence-based study, and coordinate trips to main campus with the documented lighted path or shuttle.
cards.short_summary: A lower-campus study room that lets residents work without traveling to the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Franciscan Residence Life lists a second-floor study room in Bl. Solanus Casey Hall and documents a lighted path and shuttle service to Main Campus.
cards.source_title: Bl. Solanus Casey Hall | Residence Life
cards.access_notes: This is inside a men's residence hall on Lower Campus; access is governed by residence-hall policies.

cards.entity_name: St. Junípero Serra Hall Study Rooms
cards.title: Choose among Serra's study rooms
cards.subtitle: Several residence-hall study rooms and lounges
cards.notes: Residents can select a designated study room or lounge that fits the task, then keep recreational work in the separate game areas.
cards.short_summary: Multiple study environments within a hall that also documents high-speed internet.
cards.evidence_claim: The Residence Life page says St. Junípero Serra Hall contains several study rooms and lounges and provides high-speed internet in all rooms.
cards.source_title: St. Junípero Serra Hall | Residence Life
cards.access_notes: These spaces are inside a men's residence hall; follow hall entry, common-area, and quiet-hours policies.

cards.entity_name: St. Anthony of Padua Hall Study Lounge
cards.title: Claim Padua's small-hall study lounge
cards.subtitle: Combined study lounge and common room
cards.notes: Residents can use this designated shared room for coursework; choose it when a compact hall setting suits a small working session.
cards.short_summary: A combined study lounge and common room in a 33-resident hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Residence Life page names a Study Lounge/Common Room in St. Anthony of Padua Hall and documents high-speed internet connections in resident rooms.
cards.source_title: St. Anthony of Padua Hall | Residence Life
cards.access_notes: This space is inside a men's residence hall; access is subject to residence-hall entry and shared-room policies.

warnings: Exact coordinates and direct map URLs for individual interior spaces were not verified, so those fields are null.
Five selections are residence-hall spaces with sex-specific or resident-controlled access; restrictions are stated in each card.
